locked_behavior.source_resolution_rule: A source-ref string does not count as lineage unless it resolves in the project source registry. Runtime-generated fallback boundaries explain missing authority but do not become an explicitly authored assumption.
locked_behavior.race_link_rule: Every Content Matrix row must point to a valid real RACE stage in the same authority. Legacy Reach/Act/Convert/Engage labels cannot satisfy the locked RACE contract.
locked_behavior.canonical_rule: CONTENT_MATRIX and RACE remain canonical Strategy section authorities in strategy_authority.json. Phase 2 does not create a second canonical business payload.

A topic/hook/CTA row cannot false-pass without platform dimensions/duration/cover/subtitle/music-rights/traffic/landing/attribution execution fields.
Every Content Matrix row requires WHAT / WHY / EVIDENCE / TRADEOFF / EXECUTION / MEASUREMENT plus source/assumption lineage before business readiness is READY.

Every RACE stage requires the locked Research/Action/Communication/Evaluation order plus objective/actions/output/platform/surface/culture/KPI/attribution/next-decision and the same six-field business density.
Content Matrix race_stage must resolve to a real stage in the same authority; legacy REACH/ACT/CONVERT/ENGAGE cannot substitute for the locked RACE stages.
Unknown source IDs remain visible but unresolved and keep lineage TO_VERIFY.
Runtime-generated missing boundaries cannot be mistaken for an explicitly authored assumption.
